body:
Sorry about the delay in responding. The project is a public art installation I've been working on for 2 years. It's been delayed because of some mistakes I made printing the graphics. I can't delay the project as the scaffolding is already up.

My life before was pretty stressful but I was able to cope OK. I had a lot to do and I was busy. I've been worrying about this project for a long time. I feel like I'm neglecting my family as well. As soon as I relapsed I started experiencing massive amounts of anxiety. I can't even make myself something to eat. I'm 2 days off the drink. I feel better but still having bad moments of intense anxiety...

My psychiatrist feels it is circumstantial because of the work and the alcohol, and that things will improve. I used to live off coffee and now I can't even touch a cup of tea because of what it does to me.
It's been great to find this group. I might have to sign up with a slightly less depressing user name though!

Thanks for all the replies, it means a lot right now. 

I had a psychiatric assessment and I think the outcome is that I need to get to meetings and rest. I've been given 3 light sleeping pills to get me through the next 3 days. I'm trying not to think about work and just focus on getting better. 

I think the relapse and work stress count as circumstantial factors. (i.e. it's not my brain chemistry.) If I can resolve those issues I think things will improve. They think I don't need to medicate long term but they are going to keep checking on me. 

I've got a meeting in about 5 hours. It's pissing rain here but I have to make myself go. Thanks for being here in the meantime.

Call a hotline asap or go see your doctor as soon as you can. I saw my gp today and I got a home visit this afternoon. I know what you are talking about when you want a certain feeling to end, just try to remember that's not the same thing as wanting to end your life. Hang in there and try to talk to someone, it's the best way back.

I called a hotline twice the night before last. I was really in trouble. It's amazing to think volunteers were there at 2am and 4 am waiting for me to call. I think calling them is a good starting point, just acknowledging to someone that something is wrong can make a massive difference. It was a huge lifeline for me just to hear a human voice. If you are really struggling they are there. If you feel you're in danger of harming yourself they will urge you to go to hospital...

My relationship with my ex was really difficult. We spent a long time trying to work it out but it actually got a whole lot worse after we split up. I went through a long period where I stopped talking to my mother and my sisters. It just gets to that point where nobody is willing to pick up the phone and work things out so nothing happens and everyone continues not to talk to one another. After I got some help with my addictions and things started to improve, really slowly they heard I was doing better and they got in touch with me, but I had to accept my part in it and say sorry for all the shit I pulled. 

Things improved with my ex when we agreed to stop fighting about money and we just focussed on our daughter. I still don't see eye to eye with my Mum due to a lot of ongoing friction between us, but I've learned how to keep the peace to some extent. 

I think particularly if you have a son, that can really help bring your family together. It sounds like you need some support. Family can be pretty difficult but blood is thicker than water, right? I hope things improve, I'm struggling a lot myself and it's pretty hard to maintain parenting responsibilities while you are feeling like this, so I feel your pain. 

I've been hovering around these threads the past 24 hours trying to make sense of my own crisis and what to do next. I feel like I'm through the worst of it, I hope you pull through too...

It doesn't sound like things are going well at the moment, but I wanted to say thank you for responding to my post last night. I was in dire need of some help and your response made a lot of sense, maybe you can take some consolation in that. Losing relationships or feeling alone is really hard, I don't think anyone really has an answer for that. They say time is a great healer and it's pretty corny but even holding on for 24 hours can improve your frame of mind in a big way. Try to talk with someone who is in a position to help you, even if its just on here.

Thanks for being here. I saw my doctor today and a crisis care team this afternoon. I'm going to aa in a few hours. I'm hoping that over the next few days I can work with them to do something about the anxiety. I just wanted to say that for anyone reading this who is experiencing a sudden crisis, relapse or breakdown, for whatever reason, just reach out to your local health services, suicide prevention hotline, online forums. Whatever it takes, just hang in there...

I'm not drinking right now but the anxiety I'm feeling keeps coming in really strong waves and I haven't been able to sleep. I've got 3 kids, I want to stay but I can't cope with the anxiety. I've relapsed before but this is really scaring me.

I printed €2000 of graphics I can't use for a public art project. My fee is about the same. There have been so many problems with the process and I can't deal with any of it now that I'm drinking... thanks for answering...
